subject.title: [Bug]: The project won't start on Windows and WSL.

question: Should maintainers treat the screenshot-backed Windows/WSL second-build hang as enough to choose a build-tool direction now, or require a fresh current-main Windows/WSL repro before deciding between tsdown update, wrapper fix, dependency pin, or rollback?
rationale: The failure is credible and on a supported platform surface, but the reporter's proposed fix replaces the build tool and the review did not prove the exact current-main dependency failure mode.

options.title: Require focused repro first
options.body: Ask for or run current-main Windows and WSL first-build/second-build logs before selecting a tsdown update, wrapper fix, pin, or rollback.

options.title: Promote as beta build blocker
options.body: Treat the existing screenshot as sufficient to start maintainer-owned beta-blocking build-tool work immediately.

options.title: Reject broad rollback for now
options.body: Keep the issue open for evidence but rule out a tsdown-to-tsc rollback unless later proof shows narrower fixes cannot work.

recommendation.title: Require focused repro first
recommendation.body: Ask for or run current-main Windows and WSL first-build/second-build logs before selecting a tsdown update, wrapper fix, pin, or rollback.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history points to this person as the strongest current owner for Windows-specific tsdown wrapper process handling.
